lines.t: And ceremonial symbols of the feast
Consider their meaning and rejoice in their fulfillment
Do not agonize over the details
Feast upon that which sustains the soul
Behold your salvation and the loving mercy of God
That which you partake of for the body
Rather feast upon that which disdains your soul
And the loving mercy of God
For the intent of one's heart
Than the offering put forth by their hands
The new moons and seasons are not the focus Rather Yahushua is the focus
For the significance of these holy days Is found in their meaning and revealed by their
Even as all find their fulfillment in the Messiah
and their completion in the coming of the Lord.
Yahushua is the focus, broken bread, poured out wine,
The body given, the blood shed once for all
In your passion we find our peace
In your mercy we stand redeemed
